scope: Unchanged actual process_job, isolated 44-video clone and local publication, one cold and one warm with timing probes. Qwen primed; excludes HTTP, queue, formal search-gate contention.

full_command.scope: existing 44-video clone; Qwen store temporarily hidden; independent from model-loaded upload run

index_separate_probe.note: Separate clone without benchmark-resident models. Not a paired optimization test; do not extrapolate 0.72s to the 10s upload phase.

proposed_priorities.idea: Reduce index process startup/import overhead using existing worker or lighter command; then evaluate incremental additions or CPU-index/Qwen overlap
proposed_priorities.evidence: Upload index 5.30s previously, 10.00s this warm probe. Independent CLI 3.80s; instrumented actual full index calls 0.72s. Need test full-upload improvement, not claim all 10s eliminable.

proposed_priorities.idea: Qwen sequential decode/preload original selected frame indices, bounded prefetch while encoding
proposed_priorities.evidence: 8 clips, 128 seeks: seek 2.48s, all capture operations 2.64s; model and preprocessing 13.15s. Frame identity and time alignment must stay exact.

proposed_priorities.idea: APFS clone release snapshot instead of full copytree
proposed_priorities.evidence: Measured copytree 1.88s cold / 3.35s warm; validate isolation, failed-job cleanup and deletion before deployment.

proposed_priorities.idea: Prewarm frame models or increase idle lifetime when useful
proposed_priorities.evidence: Observed cold-warm total gap 7.72s this profile, 16.11s preceding deployment; cold frame init 8.34s plus process/import overhead. Moves waiting earlier, costs resident memory.

deprioritized: More CoreML face tuning: 1.73s total in this sample
Position-embedding cache: previous gains not consistent
OWL compile: previous isolated model gain over new SDPA small; cannot add its speedup to SDPA
Reducing fps/resolution/Qwen frames/windows: quality-changing, not a default optimization
limitations: One 35.44s clip and one run per state; probes add overhead and CPU/I/O timing varies.
Nested inclusive frame timers overlap (including recursive OWL extraction). Use listed distinct components or exclusive totals, never sum all inclusive rows.
Model features include preprocessing and inference; this probe does not separate them.
No new optimization was deployed or tested as a candidate in this turn.
